fields.title: Chatbot
fields.summary: An AI chatbot demonstrating prompt engineering and conversational UX.
fields.business_problem: Users want fast, contextual answers without navigating manuals.
fields.key_features:
- Streaming responses
- Conversation memory
- Topic guardrails
fields.biggest_challenge: Balancing helpfulness with refusal on out-of-scope queries.
fields.what_learned: Prompt structure dominates output quality; eval harnesses pay for themselves.

fields.title: n8n Agent Workflow
fields.summary: Low-code agent that orchestrates web searches, summarization, and email delivery.
fields.business_problem: Manual research and reporting consumed hours per week.
fields.key_features:
- Scheduled trigger
- LLM summarization node
- Email delivery
fields.role_contribution: Built the full workflow and integrations.
fields.biggest_challenge: Reliability under rate limits and partial failures.
fields.what_learned: Workflow tools shine for glue code; isolate retries per step.

fields.title: LangChain Agent
fields.summary: ReAct-style agent with tool use and persistent memory.
fields.business_problem: Single-prompt LLM calls couldn't reason across tools.
fields.key_features:
- Tool routing
- Vector memory
- Trace logging
fields.role_contribution: Designed agent architecture and tool interfaces.
fields.biggest_challenge: Containing the agent loop when tools returned ambiguous results.
fields.what_learned: Constrain the action space; observability is non-negotiable.

fields.title: Google AI Studio Media
fields.summary: Generative media exploration using Google AI Studio for image and audio.
fields.business_problem: Marketing teams need rapid creative iteration on assets.
fields.key_features:
- Image generation
- Audio synthesis
- Prompt library
fields.role_contribution: Drove the creative experiments and integration code.

fields.title: Machine Learning (scikit-learn)
fields.summary: Classification pipeline with feature engineering and cross-validation.
fields.business_problem: Predict outcomes from a structured tabular dataset.
fields.role_contribution: Owned data prep, modeling, and evaluation.
fields.what_learned: Pipelines prevent leakage; baselines first, fancy models later.

fields.title: Campus SkillSwap
fields.summary: Django app where students trade skill-sharing sessions.
fields.business_problem: Students wanted peer learning without paid platforms.
fields.what_learned: Start with a CRUD spine; layer matching on top.
